feeds.title: DAN Europe Blog
feeds.description: Alert Diver is an online magazine published by the DAN Europe Foundation with a focus on diving safety. It is available in nine languages and aims to provide valuable information to divers. The magazine covers topics such as medical issues, research studies, accident prevention, and incident insights. Written by recognized experts in dive medicine and emergency training, Alert Diver has been helping divers since 1983.

feeds.title: Different Dive
feeds.description: Different Dive is a website dedicated to scuba diving. The site offers information, tips, guides, and resources related to various aspects of scuba diving, such as equipment reviews, diving destinations, training programs, safety tips, and perhaps even personal anecdotes or stories from the diving community.

feeds.title: Ritual Dive Blog
feeds.description: Ritual is an inclusive dive company that prioritizes the needs and safety of all its explorers. With a commitment to adventure and transparency, Ritual ensures that every experience is both enjoyable and secure. Drawing on years of dive industry expertise, they foster trust and camaraderie among divers, offering transparent and upfront services without hidden surprises. Their patient and inspiring approach encourages explorers to realize their full potential in every dive.

feeds.title: Dive3D.eu
feeds.description: Dive3D.eu is a fascinating website that combines underwater exploration, photogrammetry, and 3D modeling. It features temperature measurement data from the Kreidesee Hemmoor lake, 3D models of underwater objects, and exhibits in places like the Great Library in Alexandria, Egypt. The creator's work includes scanning wrecks like the Burdigala and the Paddle Steamer Patris. Dive3D.eu's models have even found their way into museums.

feeds.title: Corail Plongée Blog
feeds.description: Corail Plongée Réunion lets you discover the Indian Ocean and its riches all year round. First dives, training at all levels…Take advantage of the exceptional setting of Reunion Island and treat yourself to an extraordinary experience.

feeds.title: Mares Blog
feeds.description: In 1949, Ludovico Mares designed and manufactured his first masks and spearguns with one purpose in mind: to share his extreme passion for the sea and diving with the rest of the world. Mares has become the worldwide leader in manufacturing and distributing state-of-the-art scuba diving equipment and is continually setting new standards.

feeds.title: European Aquatics
feeds.description: LEN (Ligue Européenne de Natation) is the European governing body for aquatic sports affiliated with FINA. It was founded in 1927 in Bologna, Italy, and has been based in Nyon, Switzerland since 2015. LEN represents 52 national aquatics federations across Europe, covering swimming, water polo, diving, synchronized swimming, and open water swimming.

feeds.title: Fordivers Blog
feeds.description: Fordivers is an online store dedicated to ocean lovers and scuba divers. They offer a variety of clothing and accessories designed by and for those who have a passion for the sea. From unique T-shirts celebrating ocean exploration to stylish accessories, Fordivers caters to those who appreciate the underwater world. The helpful Fordiver Blog about scuba diving, sea animals, sustainable fashion and curiosities of the underwater world.

feeds.title: Splashpacker
feeds.description: Splashpacker is a website designed for conscious travelers and divers, created by a female diving instructor and solo traveler. It offers information on scuba diving, travel destinations, dive centers, and sustainable tourism. The website promotes eco-friendly practices, helps locals, and advocates for a healthy lifestyle. It also provides tips and experiences for those interested in sustainable tourism and eco travel. Additionally, Splashpacker encourages protecting the oceans and marine life.

feeds.title: Lucas Divestore Blog
feeds.description: Lucas Diving has exciting news to share about scuba equipment, gadgets, and updates. With over 35 years of experience providing dive-fun worldwide, we are proud to offer the latest products and expert advice. If you're interested in learning more about our products or seeking advice, be sure to read our blogs! We'll provide you with all the information you need to make informed decisions about our products.
